city.introEn: Malaysia's garden capital sits about 30 minutes south of Kuala Lumpur, with lakes, parks and wide boulevards. Find courts, pools, water sports, cruises, parks and landmarks across its Presints.
city.introMs: Ibu kota pentadbiran Malaysia yang hijau ini terletak kira-kira 30 minit ke selatan Kuala Lumpur, dikelilingi tasik, taman dan jalan raya yang lebar. Cari gelanggang, kolam renang, sukan air, pelayaran, taman dan mercu tanda di seluruh Presintnya.

activities.nameEn: Sightseeing cruise at Cruise Tasik Putrajaya
activities.nameMs: Pelayaran bersiar-siar di Cruise Tasik Putrajaya
activities.descriptionEn: A relaxed cruise on Putrajaya Lake from Jeti Putra, passing Putra Mosque, the government buildings and the city's bridges. A good first look at Putrajaya, especially in the late afternoon.
activities.descriptionMs: Pelayaran santai di Tasik Putrajaya dari Jeti Putra, melalui Masjid Putra, bangunan kerajaan dan jambatan-jambatan bandar. Cara mudah mengenali Putrajaya, lebih-lebih lagi pada lewat petang.

photo.altEn: Small white boat on a lake near a pink-domed mosque and minaret
photo.altMs: Bot putih kecil di tasik berhampiran masjid berkubah merah jambu dan menaranya

activities.nameEn: Dondang Sayang boat ride at Cruise Tasik Putrajaya
activities.nameMs: Perahu Dondang Sayang di Cruise Tasik Putrajaya
activities.descriptionEn: A shorter ride on a smaller, traditional-style boat that gets you closer to the water. It suits families and small groups who want a quick trip around the lake.
activities.descriptionMs: Tunggangan lebih singkat dengan bot gaya tradisional yang lebih kecil, lebih dekat dengan air. Sesuai untuk keluarga dan kumpulan kecil yang mahu bersiar-siar sekejap di tasik.

photo.altEn: Ornate traditional boats decorated with red and white flags
photo.altMs: Bot tradisional berhias dengan bendera merah dan putih

activities.nameEn: Private boat charter at Cruise Tasik Putrajaya
activities.nameMs: Sewa bot persendirian di Cruise Tasik Putrajaya
activities.descriptionEn: Hire a boat just for your group and cruise the lake on your own schedule. Ask the operator about boat sizes, routes and how far ahead to book.
activities.descriptionMs: Sewa bot khas untuk kumpulan anda dan belayar di tasik mengikut masa anda sendiri. Tanya pengendali tentang saiz bot, laluan dan berapa awal perlu menempah.

photo.altEn: Small wooden boat floating alone on a calm lake
photo.altMs: Bot kayu kecil terapung sendirian di tasik yang tenang

activities.descriptionEn: Dinner on the water while the lakeside landmarks light up around you. Menus and sailing times vary, so check with the operator before you go.
activities.descriptionMs: Makan malam di atas air sambil mercu tanda di tepi tasik bercahaya di sekeliling anda. Menu dan waktu pelayaran berbeza, jadi semak dengan pengendali sebelum pergi.

photo.altEn: Dinner table set on a boat deck overlooking water and mountains at dusk
photo.altMs: Meja makan malam di dek bot menghadap air dan gunung ketika senja

activities.nameEn: Boat hire for events at Cruise Tasik Putrajaya
activities.nameMs: Sewa bot untuk acara di Cruise Tasik Putrajaya
activities.descriptionEn: Use a boat on Putrajaya Lake for a birthday, company event or celebration. The operator can tell you capacity, catering options and rates.
activities.descriptionMs: Gunakan bot di Tasik Putrajaya untuk hari jadi, majlis syarikat atau sambutan. Pengendali boleh beritahu kapasiti, pilihan katering dan kadar.

photo.altEn: Group of people gathered on the deck of a wooden boat on the water
photo.altMs: Sekumpulan orang berkumpul di dek bot kayu di atas air

activities.nameEn: Water sports at Putrajaya Water Sports Complex
activities.nameMs: Sukan air di Kompleks Sukan Air Putrajaya
activities.descriptionEn: The Putrajaya Water Sports Complex in Presint 6 sits right on the lake and hosts paddling, rowing and towed water sports. Check with the venue which activities are open to the public on the day.
activities.descriptionMs: Kompleks Sukan Air Putrajaya di Presint 6 terletak betul-betul di tepi tasik dan menempatkan sukan dayung, mendayung dan sukan air yang ditarik bot. Semak dengan pihak venue aktiviti mana yang dibuka kepada orang ramai pada hari tersebut.

photo.altEn: Two people riding a jet ski across choppy water
photo.altMs: Dua orang menunggang jet ski merentasi air berombak

activities.nameEn: Kayaking at Putrajaya Water Sports Complex
activities.nameMs: Berkayak di Kompleks Sukan Air Putrajaya
activities.descriptionEn: Paddle a kayak on the calm water of Putrajaya Lake. A gentle way to try water sports, with the city skyline around you.
activities.descriptionMs: Berkayak di air tenang Tasik Putrajaya. Cara santai untuk mencuba sukan air, dengan pemandangan bandar di sekeliling anda.

photo.altEn: Two people paddling a kayak on a lake lined with trees
photo.altMs: Dua orang mengayuh kayak di tasik yang dikelilingi pokok

activities.nameEn: Rowing at Putrajaya Water Sports Complex
activities.nameMs: Mendayung di Kompleks Sukan Air Putrajaya
activities.descriptionEn: Rowing on the long, sheltered stretch of lake by the complex, a venue used for races and training. Ask the venue about sessions for beginners.
activities.descriptionMs: Mendayung di bahagian tasik yang panjang dan terlindung di tepi kompleks, yang digunakan untuk perlumbaan dan latihan. Tanya pihak venue tentang sesi untuk pemula.

photo.altEn: Rowing crew in a long boat silhouetted on the water
photo.altMs: Pasukan pendayung dalam bot panjang berbayang di atas air

activities.nameEn: Water skiing at Putrajaya Water Sports Complex
activities.nameMs: Ski air di Kompleks Sukan Air Putrajaya
activities.descriptionEn: Get towed behind a boat and try water skiing on Putrajaya Lake. Ask the venue about lessons, safety gear and age limits before you book.
activities.descriptionMs: Ditarik di belakang bot dan cuba ski air di Tasik Putrajaya. Tanya pihak venue tentang kelas, kelengkapan keselamatan dan had umur sebelum menempah.

photo.altEn: Water skier carving a spray across blue water
photo.altMs: Pemain ski air memercikkan air merentasi permukaan biru

activities.nameEn: Wakeboarding at Putrajaya Water Sports Complex
activities.nameMs: Wakeboarding di Kompleks Sukan Air Putrajaya
activities.descriptionEn: Ride a wakeboard on the lake, from first-timer runs to tricks. Ask the venue about lessons and safety gear before you go.
activities.descriptionMs: Menunggang papan wake di tasik, dari percubaan pertama hingga aksi. Tanya pihak venue tentang kelas dan kelengkapan keselamatan sebelum pergi.

photo.altEn: Wakeboarder silhouetted mid-jump against the setting sun
photo.altMs: Pemain papan luncur air berbayang melompat dengan latar matahari terbenam

activities.nameEn: Water recreation at Putrajaya Water Recreation Centre
activities.nameMs: Rekreasi air di Pusat Rekreasi Air Putrajaya

activities.nameEn: Wall climbing at Putrajaya Challenge Park
activities.nameMs: Panjat dinding di Taman Cabaran Putrajaya
activities.descriptionEn: Outdoor climbing walls at the Putrajaya Challenge Park in Presint 5, with routes for beginners and regular climbers. Ask the venue about instructors, gear hire and session times.
activities.descriptionMs: Dinding panjat luar di Taman Cabaran Putrajaya, Presint 5, dengan laluan untuk pemula dan pemanjat biasa. Tanya pihak venue tentang jurulatih, sewa kelengkapan dan waktu sesi.

photo.altEn: Climber on a colourful outdoor bouldering wall under a blue sky
photo.altMs: Pemanjat di dinding panjat luar yang berwarna-warni di bawah langit biru

activities.nameMs: Papan luncur di Taman Cabaran Putrajaya
activities.descriptionEn: A free skatepark with ramps and bowls for skateboards, scooters and inline skates. Busy in the evenings and at weekends.
activities.descriptionMs: Taman papan luncur percuma dengan ram dan mangkuk untuk papan luncur, skuter dan kasut roda. Sibuk pada waktu petang dan hujung minggu.

photo.altEn: Skateboarder doing a trick above a concrete skatepark bowl at sunset
photo.altMs: Pemain papan selaju melakukan aksi di atas mangkuk taman papan selaju ketika senja

activities.descriptionEn: BMX tracks and jumps in the same park, popular with local riders. Bring your own bike and a helmet.
activities.descriptionMs: Trek dan lompatan BMX di taman yang sama, popular dalam kalangan penunggang tempatan. Bawa basikal dan topi keledar sendiri.

photo.altEn: BMX rider silhouetted mid-air above a ramp at dusk
photo.altMs: Penunggang BMX berbayang di udara di atas tanjakan ketika senja

activities.nameEn: Mountain biking at Putrajaya Challenge Park
activities.nameMs: Basikal gunung di Taman Cabaran Putrajaya
activities.descriptionEn: Mountain bike trails through the park's wooded hills, from flowing paths to steeper sections. Bring your own bike and a helmet.
activities.descriptionMs: Trek basikal gunung melalui bukit berhutan di taman ini, dari laluan landai hingga bahagian yang lebih curam. Bawa basikal dan topi keledar sendiri.

photo.altEn: Mountain bikers riding a dirt trail through a green forest
photo.altMs: Penunggang basikal gunung melalui denai tanah di hutan hijau

activities.descriptionEn: Ride the paths around the Challenge Park and the nearby lakeside. An easy outing for families on bikes.
activities.descriptionMs: Berbasikal di laluan sekitar Taman Cabaran dan tepi tasik berhampiran. Aktiviti mudah untuk keluarga yang berbasikal.

photo.altEn: Person cycling along a shaded path through a green park
photo.altMs: Seorang berbasikal di laluan teduh melalui taman hijau

activities.nameEn: Horse riding at Putrajaya Equestrian Park
activities.nameMs: Menunggang kuda di Taman Ekuestrian Putrajaya

activities.descriptionMs: Gelanggang badminton dalam bangunan di kompleks kejiranan Presint 9, dikendalikan oleh Perbadanan Putrajaya. Tempah gelanggang dengan pihak venue.

photo.altEn: Four people playing badminton on a blue indoor court
photo.altMs: Empat orang bermain badminton di gelanggang dalaman berwarna biru

photo.altMs: Gelanggang skuasy kosong dengan lantai kayu dan dinding kaca belakang

photo.altMs: Pandangan udara gelanggang tenis luar dikelilingi pokok

activities.descriptionMs: Kolam renang awam di kompleks kejiranan Presint 9, dibuka mengikut sesi sepanjang hari. Semak waktu sesi dan etika pakaian sebelum pergi.

photo.altMs: Orang ramai berenang di kolam renang luar yang terang

activities.descriptionMs: Gim komuniti di kompleks kejiranan Presint 9 dengan mesin kardio dan pemberat. Tanya di kaunter tentang yuran masuk dan keahlian.

photo.altEn: Modern gym with rows of treadmills and weight machines
photo.altMs: Gim moden dengan deretan treadmill dan mesin bebanan

photo.altMs: Orang ramai bermain bola keranjang di gelanggang luar pada hari cerah

activities.nameEn: Nature walk at Putrajaya Wetland Park
activities.nameMs: Jelajah alam di Taman Wetland Putrajaya
activities.descriptionEn: Walk the boardwalks and trails of Putrajaya Wetland Park, a large man-made wetland at the north end of the lake. Look out for birds, flamingos and the lookout tower.
activities.descriptionMs: Berjalan di laluan papan dan denai Taman Wetland Putrajaya, tanah bencah buatan yang luas di hujung utara tasik. Perhatikan burung, flamingo dan menara peninjau.

photo.altEn: A group of pelicans swimming on calm water
photo.altMs: Sekumpulan burung undan berenang di air yang tenang

activities.nameMs: Memerhati burung di Taman Wetland Putrajaya
activities.descriptionEn: The wetland's lakes and reed beds attract egrets, herons and other water birds. Come early in the morning and bring binoculars.
activities.descriptionMs: Tasik dan paya buluh di tanah bencah ini menarik burung bangau, pucung dan burung air lain. Datang awal pagi dan bawa teropong.

photo.altEn: Painted stork flying low over green water
photo.altMs: Burung botak padi terbang rendah di atas air kehijauan

activities.descriptionEn: Flat, shady paths through the wetland make for an easy bike ride. Bring your own bike or ask about rentals on site.
activities.descriptionMs: Laluan rata dan redup melalui tanah bencah sesuai untuk berbasikal santai. Bawa basikal sendiri atau tanya tentang sewaan di sana.

photo.altEn: Person cycling along a shaded path through a green park
photo.altMs: Seorang berbasikal di laluan teduh melalui taman hijau

activities.descriptionEn: A large lakeside botanical garden in Presint 1 with themed gardens, a Moroccan pavilion and picnic lawns. Entry is free.
activities.descriptionMs: Taman botani yang luas di tepi tasik di Presint 1 dengan taman bertema, astaka Maghribi dan padang berkelah. Masuk percuma.

photo.altEn: Paved path curving through a leafy park with pine trees and shrubs
photo.altMs: Laluan berturap melengkung melalui taman yang rimbun dengan pokok pain dan pokok renek

activities.descriptionEn: Ride the garden's long paths along the lake. Bicycles can be rented on site, so you don't need to bring your own.
activities.descriptionMs: Berbasikal di laluan panjang taman di sepanjang tasik. Basikal boleh disewa di sana, jadi tidak perlu bawa sendiri.

photo.altEn: Person cycling along a shaded path through a green park
photo.altMs: Seorang berbasikal di laluan teduh melalui taman hijau

activities.nameEn: Walking & jogging at Putrajaya Botanical Garden
activities.nameMs: Berjalan kaki & berjoging di Taman Botani Putrajaya
activities.descriptionEn: Shady paths for a morning walk or jog among the gardens and lakeside. Free, and popular early in the day.
activities.descriptionMs: Laluan redup untuk berjalan atau berjoging pada waktu pagi di antara taman dan tepi tasik. Percuma, dan popular awal pagi.

photo.altEn: Woman jogging on a tree-lined path beside the water
photo.altMs: Wanita berjoging di laluan berpokok di tepi air

activities.nameMs: Berjoging & jelajah alam di Taman Rimba Alam

activities.nameEn: Ice skating at Icescape Ice Skating Rink
activities.nameMs: Luncur ais di Icescape Ice Skating Rink

activities.descriptionEn: The city's main square, with Putra Mosque on one side and the Prime Minister's office, Perdana Putra, at the end. A good starting point for photos and a walk along the lake.
activities.descriptionMs: Dataran utama bandar, dengan Masjid Putra di satu sisi dan Perdana Putra, pejabat Perdana Menteri, di hujungnya. Tempat mula yang baik untuk bergambar dan berjalan di tepi tasik.

photo.altEn: Pink-domed mosque with a tall minaret beside a lake
photo.altMs: Masjid berkubah merah jambu dengan menara tinggi di tepi tasik

activities.descriptionEn: Putrajaya's best-known bridge, with pedestrian walkways and lake views towards Putra Mosque. Lovely at sunset and after dark.
activities.descriptionMs: Jambatan paling terkenal di Putrajaya, dengan laluan pejalan kaki dan pemandangan tasik ke arah Masjid Putra. Cantik ketika matahari terbenam dan pada waktu malam.

photo.altEn: Arched bridge with lit towers reflected on a lake at night
photo.altMs: Jambatan melengkung dengan menara bercahaya terpantul di tasik pada waktu malam

activities.descriptionEn: A tall monument by the lake in Presint 2 that marks Malaysia's history, with a timeline along the walkway. Free, and quiet in the evening.
activities.descriptionMs: Monumen tinggi di tepi tasik di Presint 2 yang menandakan sejarah Malaysia, dengan garis masa di sepanjang laluan pejalan kaki. Percuma dan tenang pada waktu petang.

photo.altEn: Tall slender monument and a cable-stayed bridge across a calm lake, with a hot-air balloon above
photo.altMs: Monumen tinggi lagi ramping dan jambatan kabel merentangi tasik yang tenang, dengan belon udara panas di langit
